fact: The driver of Car 11 did not follow the Race Director's Event Notes regarding the escape road instructions at Turns 4/5.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 11 (Sergio Perez), the team representative and reviewed video, telemetry and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 11 stated that he lost control of the car at Turn 4/5 and felt that it would have been unsafe and difficult to go around the newly-installed green bollard. He stated that he re-joined the track safely. The Stewards agreed that this was the case. The driver and team representative expressed their strong belief that the new green bollard should be removed and that the normal methods used to determine if a lasting advantage has been gained, be applied during the race.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 Alleged Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions Escape Road
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
